keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Each keyword is a separate Grants.gov full-text search (title, description, agency), e.g. ["artificial intelligence","rural broadband"]. Leave empty to search by filters only. Results are de-duplicated across keywords.

opportunityNumbers.title: Opportunity numbers
opportunityNumbers.description: Exact funding opportunity numbers to look up, e.g. ["DE-FOA-0003631","RFA-AI-27-005"]. Misses come back as free not_found rows.

statuses.title: Opportunity statuses
statuses.description: Which opportunities to include. Default posted (open for applications) and forecasted (expected soon). Add closed or archived for past calls.

agencies.title: Agencies
agencies.description: Grants.gov agency codes, e.g. ["NSF","HHS-NIH11","DOE","USDA-NIFA"]. A top-level code ("HHS", "DOE", "USDA") includes all its sub-agencies. Leave empty for all agencies.

eligibilities.title: Eligible applicant types
eligibilities.description: Only opportunities open to these applicant types (codes or labels), e.g. ["23"] or ["Small businesses"]. Note: many calls are "Unrestricted" (99); add it to include them. Leave empty for any.

enumTitles: Nonprofits with 501(c)(3), other than higher education
Nonprofits without 501(c)(3), other than higher education
For-profit organizations other than small businesses

fundingCategories.title: Funding categories
fundingCategories.description: Only these funding activity categories, e.g. ["ST","HL"] (Science/R&D, Health). Leave empty for any.

fundingInstruments.title: Funding instruments
fundingInstruments.description: Grant, Cooperative Agreement, Procurement Contract or Other. Leave empty for any.

assistanceListings.title: Assistance listings (ALN/CFDA)
assistanceListings.description: Assistance Listing numbers, e.g. ["47.075","93.866"]. Leave empty for any.

postedWithinDays.title: Posted within (days)
postedWithinDays.description: Only opportunities posted in the last N days, e.g. 1 for a daily alert or 7 for a weekly digest. 0 = any date.

closingWithinDays.title: Closing within (days)
closingWithinDays.description: Only opportunities whose application deadline is today or within the next N days, e.g. 30. Opportunities without a deadline are excluded when set. 0 = any.

minAwardCeiling.title: Minimum award ceiling (USD)
minAwardCeiling.description: Only opportunities whose maximum award per recipient is at least this amount, e.g. 500000. Opportunities that publish no ceiling are excluded when set. 0 = any.

sortBy.title: Sort by
sortBy.description: closingSoonest (nearest deadline first, default), newest (most recently posted first) or relevance (Grants.gov keyword relevance).

maxResults.title: Max results per search
maxResults.description: Maximum opportunities returned per keyword or filter search (1-5000). Default 100.

includeDetails.title: Include award amounts, eligibility and description
includeDetails.description: Fetch each opportunity's full record: award floor/ceiling, total funding, expected awards, eligible applicants, eligibility text, cost sharing and description. Turn off for faster title/deadline-only lists (same price).

includeDescription.title: Include description text
includeDescription.description: Add the plain-text synopsis (descriptionText). Turn off for smaller rows.

maxDescriptionChars.title: Max description length
maxDescriptionChars.description: Truncate descriptionText to this many characters (200-20000). Default 4000.

dedupe.title: De-duplicate across searches
dedupe.description: Return each opportunity once even if several keywords match it (charged once). Default on.

includeStatusRows.title: Add status rows for misses (free)
includeStatusRows.description: Add one free row (status no_results, not_found, invalid_input, service_unavailable or skipped_charge_limit, with a reason) for each search that returned nothing. Not charged. Turn off for opportunities only.
